description: On the table there’s a small white plastic base with a few upright rectangular pieces, plus another loose white piece nearby. The left hand slides in from the left to steady the base as the right hand lifts the loose piece, moves it inward, and presses it down onto the upright sections, then adjusts and taps the top while the left hand keeps the base from shifting; by the end the right hand nudges one of the side pieces outward into a more open, cross-like arrangement.
